entries.text: And say, ‘My Lord, increase me in knowledge.’
Are those who know equal to those who do not know?
In the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the alternation of night and day, are signs for people of understanding.
We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves.
And on the earth are signs for those with certainty — and also in yourselves. Will you not then see?
Do they not look at the sky above them — how We built and adorned it?
And the earth — We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused to grow therein every beautiful kind.
And among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and colors.
He created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed.
Indeed, Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.
And do not walk upon the earth exultantly.
And do not claim yourselves to be pure; He knows best who is mindful of Him.
Rather, the human being is a witness against himself.
Does the human being think he will be left without purpose?
And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge.
